summary: An AI assistant can now work in PIM Manager on your behalf, within your own role and approvals.

new.title: AI assistant connection (Pro, preview)
new.text: An AI assistant can read PIM Manager, stage changes and commit them, signed in as you, within your role and the normal approvals. Nothing is ever activated.

fixes.title: Access request portal gets updates
fixes.text: The access request portal now updates with the rest of PIM Manager, and a failed update is shown clearly.
